title: Sardinians said to descend from giants

tellings.quote: Well, they actually they say some of them that they were descended from giants.

plain: A researcher named Tim Alberino tells a podcast host, Jesse Michels, about a belief on the Italian island of Sardinia. According to Alberino, some Sardinians say they are descended from giants, which would tie the local people to an ancient race of very large humans.
